system.description:
Nethri possess exceptionally fine sensory filaments along the head, neck and limbs. These structures constantly exchange minute chemical and spiritual signals with surrounding Myrathi, creating a subtle level of communication outsiders rarely notice.
Nethri gatherings can therefore appear unnaturally quiet. Entire conversations may take place through tiny changes of posture, scent and transmitted impressions before a spoken word becomes necessary. This does not make Nethri a hive mind—individual thought remains entirely distinct—but it does give them a reputation for emotional sensitivity and an ability to recognise tension within a group before anybody openly acknowledges it.
You gain a +1 racial bonus to Sense Motive checks. In addition, you can communicate silently with willing Myrathi within 60 feet, provided you share a language and neither of you is completely sealed away from the surrounding air.

effects.description: +1 racial bonus to Sense Motive checks.
